instruct: A woman's voice, low-pitched and warm, slightly deeper than average, unhurried, with precise economical diction — every word placed like a tool returned to its slot. Calm master-craftswoman confidence, quiet grounded authority; a subtle audible smile at the edges, never performed.

text: Here — try it now. The handle has stopped arguing with your hand, and that little snag you kept tripping on is gone. You did the work; I only moved a buckle. Mm — look at that. I do love watching a mortal become.
